subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Say what people do in each job.
Use job words in your own sentences.

tf.why: Yes, puppeteers make puppets move and talk.

tf.s: A comedian makes people laugh by telling jokes.
A make-up artist writes stories for films.
tf.why: A make-up artist puts make-up on actors' faces.

tf.s: A stunt performer does dangerous things for films.
tf.why: Yes, so they need to be very fit.

tf.s: A camera operator usually performs on the stage.
tf.why: A camera operator videos the show; you don't see them on stage.

tf.s: Clowns often wear wigs, red noses and big shoes.
tf.why: Yes, that is how we know a clown.

tf.s: An animator makes cartoons and moving pictures.
A costume designer edits the sound in a film.
tf.why: A costume designer makes clothes for performers; a sound editor works with sound.

tf.s: A presenter introduces a programme and talks to the audience.
tf.why: Yes, that is a presenter's job.

tf.s: A sound editor needs to be very fit for dangerous actions.
tf.why: Stunt performers need to be fit; sound editors work with sound.

boxes.why: A comedian makes people laugh with jokes.

boxes.q: Who uses a camera to video a show?
boxes.why: A camera operator videos the show.

boxes.q: Who wears a red nose and big shoes?
boxes.why: Clowns wear wigs, red noses and big shoes.

boxes.q: Which job do you NOT see on a stage?
boxes.why: A sound editor works behind the scenes.

boxes.q: Which job needs a very fit person?
I love drawing cartoons. I'd like to be an ___.

boxes.why: A vet is a doctor for animals.

mcq.q: Which job is this? He makes people laugh by telling jokes.
Write the job: She puts make-up on actors' faces.
mcq.why: A make-up artist does actors' make-up.

mcq.q: What is Majid going to do in the talent show?
o: He's going to be the camera operator.
He's going to be a clown.

mcq.q: You're very good at telling funny stories. You would be a great ___.
mcq.why: Funny stories make people laugh, like a comedian.

mcq.q: Hanan is creative and loves making clothes. Which job is good for her?
mcq.why: A costume designer makes clothes for performers.

mcq.q: Which sentence describes a job correctly?
o: A stunt performer does dangerous things for films.
A writer puts make-up on actors.
mcq.why: Only the first matches the job.

mcq.q: Which two jobs need people who are very fit?
mcq.why: They do dangerous or energetic actions.

mcq.q: Which group of jobs do you NOT usually see on a stage?
mcq.why: These people work behind the scenes.

mcq.q: What is the difference between a performer and a presenter?
o: A performer acts, sings or does tricks; a presenter introduces a programme.
A performer writes books; a presenter draws cartoons.
They do exactly the same job.
A presenter does stunts; a performer edits sound.
mcq.why: Performers entertain with acts; presenters talk to the audience.
